name: @piprail/example-x402-parity-sandbox
description: Live end-to-end test harness for the x402-PARITY features of the PUBLISHED @piprail/sdk + @piprail/mcp — verifiable receipts, the `upto` metered rail, the merchant-proof spend leash (POL-1), and the A2A (Google Agent2Agent) transport — plus the MCP's 8th tool, piprail_verify_receipt. Installs the real npm packages (NOT the workspace build) so it proves what `npm i @piprail/sdk` actually ships works on Base mainnet.
comment: Static assertions run with no funded wallet, no secrets, and spend nothing (a few read public RPC read-only). The LIVE sections spend TINY amounts of real Base-mainnet USDC and only run when ../../../.secrets/wallets/evm-wallet.json is present; otherwise they self-skip cleanly. The dependency pins are the LATEST PUBLISHED versions on purpose — this harness is a guarantee about the npm artifact, not the working tree (the workspace build is tested by ../sdk-sandbox), and lib/env.mjs throws if @piprail/sdk ever resolves outside this sandbox.
